_comment: Revision (LR intercept): the published logreg learner (liblinear) L2-penalizes the intercept, so with few labels the 0.5 threshold falls inside the majority mass and Margin queries rare cases at chance. This config re-runs every benchmark with the same model and an unpenalized intercept (logreg_lbfgs), all 27 strategies, five Margin replicates (noise floor), the fixed-test evaluation set on the synthetic grid and the threshold diagnostics. Same states and seeds as the campaign, so results pair with results/campaign. Cost ~35 core-hours. Run: rare-al run --config configs/eswa/rev_lbfgs.json --only real image, then --only synthetic rarity
